map.正常空腹胃泌素参考范围因实验室略有差异，通常为13-115 pg/mL或＜100: Normal fasting gastrin reference ranges vary slightly by laboratory, typically 13-115 pg/mL or <100 pg/mL. Blood must be drawn fasting.

Those with MEN1 should be tested for parathyroid hormone and pituitary hormones. Recheck gastrin 2 weeks after PPI discontinuation. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：胃泌素（Gastrin）水平与高胃泌素血症鉴别: 📚 Deep Dive: Gastrin Level and Differential Diagnosis of Hypergastrinemia
map.ZES 筛查：高胃泌素伴高胃酸时排查胃泌素瘤: ZES screening: rule out gastrinoma when high gastrin accompanies high gastric acid
map.萎缩性胃炎鉴别：高胃泌素伴低酸为反馈性升高: Atrophic gastritis differentiation: high gastrin with low acid indicates feedback elevation
map.随访监测：PPI 使用者停药 2 周后复查避免假阳性: Follow-up monitoring: recheck 2 weeks after PPI discontinuation to avoid false positives
map.算法：参考范围通常 13~115 pg/mL。判定：<100 正常；100~50: Algorithm: the reference range is usually 13~115 pg/mL. Decision: <100 normal; 100~500 mild elevation; 500~1000 moderate elevation (rule out gastrinoma); ≥1000 marked elevation (highly suspicious for ZES). Combined with gastric pH: at high acid (pH<2) elevation mostly points to gastrinoma/ZES; at low acid (pH>2) it is mostly atrophic gastritis, pernicious anemia, or PPI-induced feedback elevation. PPI and hypercalcemia can raise gastrin.
map.例：空腹胃泌素 150 pg/mL、胃液 pH 低（酸性）→ 轻度升高（需关注）: Example: fasting gastrin 150 pg/mL, low gastric pH (acidic) → mild elevation (needs attention); check Hp, recheck gastrin, and if persistently elevated with refractory ulcers perform a secretin stimulation test. If 850 pg/mL with low pH → moderate elevation (500~1000), highly suspicious for gastrinoma (ZES); secretin stimulation test plus imaging localization (CT/MRI/68Ga-DOTATATE PET-CT) is advised, and check PTH and pituitary hormones to exclude MEN1.
map.伴高胃酸时高度怀疑 ZES，但需促胰液素激发试验确诊（胃泌素升高 >120 pg: With high gastric acid it is highly suspicious for ZES, but confirmation requires a secretin stimulation test (gastrin rise >120 pg/mL is positive). If gastric acid is low, it is mostly feedback elevation from severe atrophic gastritis/pernicious anemia; recheck after PPI discontinuation rather than treating it directly as a tumor.
map.吃 PPI 会让胃泌素升高多少？: How much can PPI raise gastrin?
map.长期大剂量 PPI 可反馈性使胃泌素升高数倍，多数仍在数百 pg/mL 范围，停: Long-term high-dose PPI can raise gastrin several-fold through feedback, mostly still in the hundreds pg/mL range, and it falls within 1~2 weeks after discontinuation. If the elevation is marked (>1000) with high acid, gastrinoma should still be ruled out rather than simply attributed to PPI.
